steps.title: Start with a leg, 2 pieces and a rail
steps.instruction: Join a leg, 2 pieces and a rail (A, B, C, D), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A leg, 2 pieces and a rail are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the SATSUMAS plant stand (2). Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (leg, about 80 cm), B (piece, about 25 cm), C (rail, about 28 cm), D (piece, about 25 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 80 cm tall.
In 3 assembly videos, people took about 1½ minutes on this step. Take your time.
